name: Agent Zero
tagline: Works through data-broker listings of you and files the official opt-outs
description: It hunts down the broker and people-finder pages that publish your details, then files removal requests one at a time - but only the ones you approve. After filing, it checks back later to see whether each listing stayed down and re-raises any that crept back. Consent comes first: nothing goes out without your yes.
author: GrokBotRadar
